# later jobs, because every job reads its configuration from its own base commit.

[athena]
schema = 1

[models]
# The reader turns a request into a reading; it picks the producer from `producer_allowed`.
reader = "claude-sonnet-5-5"
producer_default = "claude-sonnet-5-5"
producer_allowed = ["claude-haiku-5-5", "claude-sonnet-5-5"]
# The verifier must never be a model that can produce (nothing verifies its own work).
verifier = "claude-opus-5-5"
# The effort level each role runs at (Claude Code's `--effort`: low, medium, high, xhigh or max). Every
# invocation record names the model and effort it ran with.
reader_effort = "medium"
producer_effort = "medium"
verifier_effort = "high"
# A reading that judges its job hard (for example one that changes landing, the history check or records)
# gives the producer this model and effort instead, and records why. The model must be in `producer_allowed`:
# the verifier's model may not produce, so the stronger setting is a higher effort on the stronger allowed model.
hard_producer_model = "claude-sonnet-5-5"
hard_producer_effort = "high"

[models.names]
# Display names, used in Co-Authored-By trailers on landing commits.
"claude-opus-5-5" = "Claude Opus 5.5"
"claude-sonnet-5-5" = "Claude Sonnet 5.5"
"claude-haiku-5-5" = "Claude Haiku 5.5"

[budget]
reader_usd = 0.50
producer_usd = 3.00
verifier_usd = 2.00
job_usd = 12.00
max_readings = 5
reader_timeout_s = 300
producer_timeout_s = 3000
verifier_timeout_s = 2400
check_timeout_s = 1800
# The longest the checks stage waits for the CI run of the candidate (read every 20 seconds) before it runs
# the checks locally.
ci_wait_s = 1500

[agents]
# The worker is held constant: Claude Code at this version (see D03).
claude_version = "2.1.302"
# Agents start with an empty environment. These variables are always passed.
env_pass = ["HOME", "PATH"]
# These are passed only when set: locale and user, toolchain locations, Claude Code's own credentials and
# endpoint, GitHub credentials for the steward's read-only `gh` (D96), and the machine's network settings
# (proxies and certificate bundles).
env_pass_if_set = [
    "LANG", "LC_ALL", "LC_CTYPE", "TMPDIR", "USER", "LOGNAME", "TERM", "TZ",
    "RUSTUP_HOME", "CARGO_HOME",
    "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN", "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL",
    "GH_TOKEN", "GITHUB_TOKEN", "GH_HOST", "GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN",
    "HTTPS_PROXY", "HTTP_PROXY", "NO_PROXY", "https_proxy", "http_proxy", "no_proxy",
    "NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS", "SSL_CERT_FILE", "SSL_CERT_DIR", "CARGO_HTTP_CAINFO",
]
bash_default_timeout_ms = 600000
bash_max_timeout_ms = 1200000
# Context the host injects even into hermetic agents: about 590 tokens with no tools (design Appendix A, E3
# and E8), and about 1,070 with the structured-output tool that `--json-schema` adds for every role, measured
# on 2026-10-10 by the live test live_the_contract_is_within_its_budget.
host_baseline_tokens = 1070

[capabilities.change]
# Commands each executing role may run through Bash, by program and allowed first argument.
# "*" allows any arguments; path arguments are always confined to the agent's own snapshot.
producer_commands = { cargo = ["build", "check", "test", "clippy", "fmt", "run", "metadata", "tree", "doc"], git = ["status", "diff", "log", "show"], ls = ["*"], rm = ["*"], mv = ["*"], chmod = ["*"] }
# The verifier never writes: the hook allows its `cargo fmt` only with `--check`.
verifier_commands = { cargo = ["build", "check", "test", "clippy", "fmt", "run", "metadata", "tree"], git = ["status", "diff", "log", "show"], ls = ["*"] }

[capabilities.change.env]
# Each job builds in its own directories, one per side (D46). {job_dir} and {side} are filled in by Athena.
CARGO_TARGET_DIR = "{job_dir}/target/{side}"
CARGO_TERM_COLOR = "never"

[[capabilities.change.checks]]
name = "fmt"
run = ["cargo", "fmt", "--all", "--check"]
# A change of only prose (docs/ or any .md file) is not checked by fmt or clippy, which read no prose.
skip_when_only = ["docs/", "*.md"]

[[capabilities.change.checks]]
name = "clippy"
run = ["cargo", "clippy", "--all-targets", "--locked", "--", "-D", "warnings"]
skip_when_only = ["docs/", "*.md"]

# The test check never skips. xtask/tests/policy.rs reads docs/*.md, and its boundary scan reads every tracked
# file, .md files included, so a prose change can fail a test.
[[capabilities.change.checks]]
name = "test"
kind = "test"
run = ["cargo", "test", "--locked"]

[capabilities.study]
# A study is committed files, so it gets the same commands and gates as a change.
# The repository a study reads. Athena resolves the ref to a commit before dispatch and mounts that tree
# read-only at pinned-source/ for the producer and the verifier. A study job refuses to start without both.
repo_url = "https://github.com/kunchenguid/firstmate.git"
repo_ref = "main"
producer_commands = { cargo = ["build", "check", "test", "clippy", "fmt", "run", "metadata", "tree", "doc"], git = ["status", "diff", "log", "show"], ls = ["*"], rm = ["*"], mv = ["*"], chmod = ["*"] }
verifier_commands = { cargo = ["build", "check", "test", "clippy", "fmt", "run", "metadata", "tree"], git = ["status", "diff", "log", "show"], ls = ["*"] }

[capabilities.study.env]
CARGO_TARGET_DIR = "{job_dir}/target/{side}"
CARGO_TERM_COLOR = "never"

[[capabilities.study.checks]]
name = "fmt"
run = ["cargo", "fmt", "--all", "--check"]

[[capabilities.study.checks]]
name = "clippy"
run = ["cargo", "clippy", "--all-targets", "--locked", "--", "-D", "warnings"]

[[capabilities.study.checks]]
name = "test"
kind = "test"
run = ["cargo", "test", "--locked"]

[classes]
# The closed list of classes of work (D42). Adding a class is a job.
list = ["code", "tests", "docs", "prompts", "config", "build", "design", "other"]

[forecast.reference]
# The reference forecaster's priors, used until history accumulates (design §9.2).
p_reading_accepted = 0.7
p_verification_passes = 0.75
p_user_intervenes = 0.2
pseudo_count = 4.0
cost_usd = { p10 = 0.15, p50 = 0.60, p90 = 2.50 }
wall_time_s = { p10 = 120.0, p50 = 420.0, p90 = 1500.0 }

[secrets]
# Reviewed gitleaks allow-list entries, each with a reason. Commit an entry before the commit it excuses.
allowlist = []

[tools.gitleaks]
version = "8.30.1"
sha256 = { linux_x64 = "551f6fc83ea457d62a0d98237cbad105af8d557003051f41f3e7ca7b3f2470eb", linux_arm64 = "e4a487ee7ccd7d3a7f7ec08657610aa3606637dab924210b3aee62570fb4b080", darwin_x64 = "dfe101a4db2255fc85120ac7f3d25e4342c3c20cf749f2c20a18081af1952709", darwin_arm64 = "b40ab0ae55c505963e365f271a8d3846efbc170aa17f2607f13df610a9aeb6a5" }

[history]
# The records-history cutover (docs/design/records-history.md sections 4 and 10, D111): the id of the job
# whose landing is the cutover. C0 is the host commit of that job's landing record on athena/records. When that
# job lands, athena imports records/ at C0 and writes the legacy-exempt record from the exempt list below.
# Commits up to and including C0 are judged by the old rules; later commits only by the attribution check.
cutover_job = "20261025-001232-vesh"
# Commits that predate Athena and are exempt from the governed-content invariant (design §7.3). Each entry is
# a full commit id, and a commit that adds one must already have that commit in its history (D60).
# 64ecdc9 is a parentless second root that Athena's own commit path wrote during job 20261010-132713-ezm8;
# it joined main through the merge of the bootstrap (361a786) and fails the records-based landing check.
# ee4b0dd1aa6fcd81289dc988d0f7bd38fd7a40ef is the squash of PR #8, which carried several jobs' landings in one
# commit; the landing check refuses that shape. Excused by the user's choice of option (a) in D66: this one
# commit's content skips the invariant, and its jobs' own records still get the per-record checks.
# f2a8453380196b95f2e2cc629ffa969af57e6c85 is the squash of PR #9. Most of that PR's jobs predate
# athena.candidate/2, so the chain landing rule (D69) cannot link them (D70).
# 5a734782e76daac9b12bd8833c97a73927c8cf94 is the squash of PR #14. It changes records/ but names no job,
# so the per-job records check cannot tie its content to a job (D76).
# 39962ed02fec9da2d87cd4a3e287121ed229cd0f is the squash of PR #130. It carried two jobs' landings:
# 20261010-154004-60r4 (its PR #129 was closed unmerged) and 20261017-121143-sg0j. The chain between them is
# broken, so the history check finds that neither landing is valid in that commit. Excused as ee4b0dd (D66)
# and f2a8453 (D70) were: this one commit's content skips the invariant, and each job's own records still get
# the per-record checks.
# 02837e0 is the squash of PR #149 (job 20261018-145008-k7fq), merged by hand around athena land. Its
# content carries two hand changes beside the job's verified content, so it is not a valid landing. Excused
# with Sri's approval of 2026-10-23 (BRIEF.md addendum of that date) as 39962ed was. The commit that adds this
# entry reverts the job's own content, to re-land through Athena; the two hand changes stay.
exempt = ["49c6ac1524677b8091081115fb5d410ed6d2b2ea", "64ecdc9aa4fd24cbe4d4884c864d7e9041585c3d", "ee4b0dd1aa6fcd81289dc988d0f7bd38fd7a40ef", "f2a8453380196b95f2e2cc629ffa969af57e6c85", "5a734782e76daac9b12bd8833c97a73927c8cf94", "39962ed02fec9da2d87cd4a3e287121ed229cd0f", "02837e0d47783e9a4af0fd139d5b11adbcbb217b"]

[records]
max_file_bytes = 1048576

[personal_data]
# Email addresses allowed in committed content. An entry ending in "@" allows that local part ("noreply@");
# one starting with "@" allows that domain; one starting with "." allows every domain under that suffix.
# These are no-reply addresses, the documentation domains, and the reserved top-level domains (RFC 2606),
# none of which can belong to a person.
email_allow = ["noreply@", "@example.com", "@example.org", "@example.net", ".invalid", ".test", ".example"]

# Athena asks the host to merge a pull request once its checks are green, so `athena land --pr` finishes
# the landing without a manual merge step. Red or pending checks never trigger a merge.
[landing]
merge_via_rest = true

# How many jobs `athena drain` runs at once: the independent items of one plan group (no dependency, disjoint
# touched paths). 1 is one job at a time, as before; the schema allows 1 to 8. Left at 1 here, so adding the
# section changes nothing until the user raises it.
[parallel]
max_concurrency = 1

# How many queued items `athena plan` and `athena drain` treat as urgent and as high. An item over a cap is
# demoted one tier, in memory, for that plan only: no request or priority record is rewritten, and an item whose
# priority a person set with a priority record is never demoted. These are the defaults, written out.
[priority_caps]
urgent = 3
high = 10

# Job planning (docs/design/job-planning.md): a planner and a critic run before the producer of a change job.
# The caps are the design's. `mode = "hard"` plans only a job whose reading is marked hard, the marking that also
# escalates the producer: a job that adds or changes a rule that can refuse or hold work, or changes landing, the
# history check, records, the run pipeline or the drain. Every other job runs the producer and verifier only.
# `mode = "all"` plans every change job. `enabled = false` turns planning off whatever the mode (D110, D143).
[job_plan]
enabled = true
mode = "hard"
planner_usd = 0.75
critic_usd = 0.75
planner_timeout_s = 600
critic_timeout_s = 600
max_rounds = 3
"
